claim: An agent run is serialized per session and covers intake, context assembly, inference, tool execution, streaming, and persistence.
The runtime consumes native toolCall blocks, executes tools, appends tool results, and continues model inference.
Session state is keyed and persisted as the runtime record of a conversation.
Memory is retrieved on demand through dedicated memory search/get tools.
Tools have schemas and runtime policy enforcement outside the prompt.
Repeated and unproductive tool calls are detected and bounded.
Stable identity, tools, workspace context, and runtime context are assembled as distinct prompt concerns.
Structured runtime logging is an operational interface for gateway and agent events.
Think runs multi-step model/tool loops and persists them with an agent runtime.
Programmatic submissions provide durable idempotent FIFO processing suited to webhook-originated work.
Actions provide durable idempotency and structured failures for side effects.
Cloudflare Agent sessions use Durable Object storage for persisted message state.
Lifecycle hooks expose turn and response boundaries needed for recovery and delivery integration.
Model and tool spans can be traced while message and tool payload storage remains configurable.
